Name: Amasiah, Son of Zichri
Summary: Amasiah, son of Zichri, willingly offered himself unto the LORD and commanded two hundred thousand mighty men of valour under Jehoshaphat.
KeyStory: Next to Jehohanan was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD, with two hundred thousand mighty men.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
